# Cyrus move-day runbook (draft, r34, 2026-10-11)

How to move Cyrus out of the Nxeon app into its own deployment, and how to go back. Nothing here has been done. The
owner decisions (wallet, sign-in, domain) are NOT made; this runbook is written for the DEFAULT the code ships with,
**"Nxeon is the payment and identity provider"**, and notes where the other option changes a step.

## 0. What already makes this possible
- **Direction A (Cyrus asks Nxeon):** every platform need goes through `lib/cyrus/host` (`CyrusHost`). Inside Nxeon,
  `host/nxeon.ts` answers with the existing code. Outside, `host/http.ts` (`createHttpHost`) answers over a signed
  HTTP API that Nxeon serves with `host/http-server.ts` (`createHostServer(nxeonHost, ...)`). One conformance suite
  (`test/cyrus-host-http.test.ts`) passes on both, including settings, sign-in subjects, servers, file sessions,
  installs, the wallet and mod pages. Seam baseline: 5 imports left, all client-safe or pure (rbac role table, net
  policy JSON, token UI component, Terraria version table, mod-health log rules): copy them on move day.
- **Direction B (Nxeon asks Cyrus):** Cyrus API v1 (`/api/cyrus/v1`, `docs/api/cyrus-v1.openapi.yaml`), the Nxeon
  client and webhook receiver in `lib/cyrus-client` (imports nothing from Cyrus, stays in Nxeon).

## 1. Data to migrate (Cyrus-owned, into Cyrus' own Postgres)
| What | Where today | How |
|---|---|---|
| `ModBuild` + every `Cyrus*` table (the `CyrusDb` list in `lib/cyrus/host/types.ts`) | Nxeon Postgres | `pg_dump -t` those tables only; restore into the Cyrus DB; row counts + checksums per table |
| Built jars | `cyrusConfig().modbuildDir` on the web host | rsync; `jarSha256` on each row verifies every file |
| Uploads, imports, Test Flight / meshgen / sound roots | paths in `lib/cyrus/config.ts` | rsync; set the same env names on the new host |
| Library objects + staging catalog | library object store, `/tank/cyrus-library-staging` | copy the bucket/dir; rebuild the search index |
| API idempotency / webhook outbox | memory today; tables proposed in `prisma/manual-migration-cyrus-api-v1.sql` | create in the Cyrus DB (approve first) |

Stays in Nxeon (Cyrus reaches it only through the host API): `User`, `Server`, `ServerMod`, `GameMod`, `Job`,
`Setting`, `AuditLog`, `WalletTransaction`, `Notification`, and the Stripe customers/subscriptions in Nxeon's account
(`CyrusPlan` rows keep their `stripeSubscriptionId`, which still points into Nxeon's Stripe in the default mode).
Foreign keys from Cyrus tables to `User.id` become plain stable subject ids (no cross-database FK).

## 2. Secrets and config
New in Cyrus: its `DATABASE_URL`; the host API key (`keyId` + `secret`) for `createHttpHost`; `CYRUS_API_V1_KEYS`
(sha256 of Nxeon's token) and `CYRUS_API_V1_SUBJECT_KEYS` (Nxeon's Ed25519 PUBLIC key only); `CYRUS_API_V1_WEBHOOKS=1`,
`CYRUS_API_V1_WEBHOOK_URL`, `CYRUS_API_V1_WEBHOOK_SECRET` (dedicated, >= 32 chars, never `AUTH_SECRET`); the model-provider
keys and the modbuilder env file (`MODBUILDER_ENV_FILE`); the library URL secret; `CYRUS_BUILD_HOST` and paths.
New in Nxeon: the Cyrus service token (`cyk_...`), the subject PRIVATE key, the webhook secret (receiver), the host API
secret per Cyrus key (`createHostServer({ secretFor })`). Own-Stripe option only: Cyrus' Stripe keys + its own webhook.
Never copy: Nxeon's `AUTH_SECRET`, SSH keys, Proxmox tokens, Nxeon's Stripe secret (the default needs none in Cyrus).

## 3. Domain, cookies, sign-in
- Default: Cyrus on its own host name (owner picks, e.g. `cyrus.<domain>`); sign-in **from Nxeon** (Nxeon mints the
  subject; Cyrus keeps a session for that `sub`, never an email). Cookies are host-only on the Cyrus domain; no shared
  parent-domain cookie with Nxeon.
- Keep `/mods/cyrus` and `/dashboard/cyrus` on Nxeon as 301s to the new paths (SEO + bookmarks) for at least 12 months.
- Own-accounts option: Cyrus' own login; link accounts once by a signed Nxeon handoff, then key everything on Cyrus' id.

## 4. Cutover (one maintenance window, about 30 min)
1. Before: Cyrus deployed on its host with `setHost(createHttpHost({ baseUrl, keyId, secret, db, session, builds }))`
   at boot and `warm()`; Nxeon mounts the host API route (`createHostServer(nxeonHost, …)`) behind its own flag.
   Dual-run in staging: the conformance suite against the mounted Nxeon endpoint.
2. Freeze: Cyrus writes off in Nxeon (studio, builds, delivery flags off); drain the build queue (no `queued`/`running`).
3. Copy data (section 1), verify counts/checksums/jar hashes.
4. Point DNS / reverse proxy for the Cyrus host name; turn on the 301s in Nxeon.
5. Turn on in Cyrus: API v1, webhooks; in Nxeon: the client + webhook receiver route.
6. Smoke: sign-in handoff, list projects, one build on a test account, one install on a test server (never a
   customer server), a wallet charge + refund of 1 cent on a test account, one webhook received.
7. Remove the in-Nxeon Cyrus routes from navigation (code stays until rollback window ends).

Webhook emission points to wire before cutover (not wired yet): build settle in `lib/modbuilder/store.ts` syncBuild
(build.finished), `lib/cyrus-mods/pages.ts` page sync (mod.published), the delivery job result (install.result,
delivery.rolledback), the contribution outcome (library.contributed). Each through `emitWebhook` (no-op while off).

## 5. Rollback (any time in the first 14 days)
1. Cyrus writes off on the new host; DNS back; 301s off in Nxeon; the old in-Nxeon flags back on.
2. Copy back rows created on the new host since cutover (by `createdAt`/`updatedAt` > cutover) for the Cyrus tables,
   plus new jars. Because ids are cuids and nothing was deleted, this is an upsert, not a merge.
3. Nothing in Nxeon's own tables changed shape, so Nxeon needs no rollback beyond flags.

## 6. Risks to watch
Wallet charges are idempotent over the host API only inside one Nxeon instance (in-memory replay cache); add a unique
reference column before running several. Delivery still SSHes from Nxeon into customer VMs; Cyrus only ever holds file
sessions bound to its key. Subject = Nxeon user id in the default; if accounts split later, keep a mapping table.

23639:- **Service tokens**: `Authorization: Bearer cyk_<keyId>_<secret>`. `CYRUS_API_V1_KEYS` holds only `sha256(secret)` per key with `client`, `scopes`, `rpm` (default 120/min); several keys per client = rotation. Scopes: `projects:read`, `builds:read`, `catalog:read` live; `*:write`, `installs:*`, `mods:read`, `account:read`, `webhooks:manage`, `admin:read` reserved. `mintServiceToken()` in `signing.ts` makes a token + hash.
23640:- **Subject assertion**: header `Cyrus-Subject` = `b64url(JSON {v:1, iss, sub, aud:"cyrus-api-v1", iat, exp, jti, kid?})` + `.` + `b64url(Ed25519 signature)`. The caller (Nxeon) holds the private key; `CYRUS_API_V1_SUBJECT_KEYS` holds public keys (base64 DER SPKI) per client + `kid`. `iss` must be the token's client, lifetime at most 120 s (30 s skew), `jti` single use (in-process replay cache), `sub` is the stable subject id (today the Nxeon user id); a payload with an `email` field or an `@` in `sub` is refused.

## Cyrus separation finish + API v1 phase 2 (2026-10-11, branch `feature/cyrus-r34-separation2`, NOT deployed, every switch OFF)
No behaviour change inside Nxeon: every new host method delegates to the same function as before; every API addition is behind `CYRUS_API_V1` (off) and each feature's own flag.

**Host seam finished.** `test/fixtures/cyrus-host-seam-baseline.json` went from 40 imports in 26 files to **5** (all client-safe or pure: `admin/perms.ts -> lib/rbac` role table, `capabilities.ts -> net-policy.json`, `forge.ts -> components/cyrus-tokens`, `games/terraria.ts -> lib/terraria-image`, `lifecycle/logs.ts -> lib/mod-health`). How:
- Pure build-engine modules moved into Cyrus: `lib/modbuilder/{types,client}.ts -> lib/cyrus/builder/`, `lib/cyrus-mods/doc.ts -> lib/cyrus/mods/doc.ts`, `toView -> lib/cyrus/builder/view.ts`, `MODBUILD_DIR`/`jarPathFor -> lib/cyrus/builder/paths.ts`. The old paths re-export, so the platform's importers are unchanged.
- New host interfaces (types in `lib/cyrus/host/types.ts`, Nxeon delegates in `host/nxeon.ts`): `host.builds` (sync, create, accessUser, accountFor, mergeCyrusKey -> `lib/modbuilder`), `host.mods` (serviceBuildId, onBuildSettled -> `lib/cyrus-mods`), `host.billing` (`provider: "host"`; `stripe` = Nxeon's `lib/stripe` + `lib/stripe-cards`; `wallet` = balance/charge/refund over `lib/wallet` + a `WalletTransaction` row, unused by Cyrus today). `lib/cyrus/tokens/{billing,state,sweep}.ts` no longer import `lib/stripe`.
- **Default, not a decision:** Nxeon is the payment and identity provider. The alternative adapter `lib/cyrus/host/billing-own-stripe.ts` (Cyrus' own Stripe, no wallet) is built and unused.
- `lib/modbuilder/access.ts`: `modBuilderAccess(user)` extracted from `modBuilderUser()` (same decision), used for API subjects.

**API v1 writes** (`lib/cyrus/api/v1/writes.ts`, real wiring `deps-writes.ts`): `POST /projects`, `POST /builds`, `POST /installs` + `GET /installs/{id}` (the delivery handler with the subject as caller; `CYRUS_DELIVERY` must also be on), `POST /projects/{id}/config` (Config Studio service; `CYRUS_CONFIG_STUDIO`), `POST /library/contributions` (contribution pipeline; community legal classes only; `CYRUS_LIBRARY_CONTRIBUTE`). New scopes `config:write`, `library:write`. Every write: `Idempotency-Key` required (same key + same request = first answer replayed with `idempotent-replay: true`; different request = 422; still running = 409; scope = token key + subject + operation), the Mod Builder access rule for the subject (403 `not_allowed`), one `AuditLog` row `cyrus.api.<op>`. Idempotency is in-process until the proposed table exists.

**Webhooks Cyrus -> Nxeon** (`lib/cyrus/api/v1/webhooks.ts`): builders for build.finished, mod.published, install.result, delivery.rolledback, library.contributed (deterministic ids); `WebhookOutbox` interface + memory store; `dispatchWebhooks` signs (`Cyrus-Signature: v1=HMAC(secret, id.ts.body)`), retries 1 m / 5 m / 30 m / 2 h / 12 h then dead. Config `CYRUS_API_V1_WEBHOOKS=1`, `CYRUS_API_V1_WEBHOOK_URL`, `CYRUS_API_V1_WEBHOOK_SECRET` (>= 32 chars, never `AUTH_SECRET`; otherwise off). No product code emits yet (emission points in `docs/CYRUS-MOVE-RUNBOOK.md`).

**Nxeon-side client** (`lib/cyrus-client/`, imports nothing from `lib/cyrus`): `createCyrusClient` (typed calls for every live operation, Ed25519 subject assertions, stable Idempotency-Key across its retries) and `receiveCyrusWebhook` (HMAC with rotation, 300 s window, exactly-once by id, handler failure = 500 so Cyrus retries). Mounted nowhere.

**Proposed SQL (NOT run):** `prisma/manual-migration-cyrus-api-v1.sql` (`CyrusApiIdempotency`, `CyrusWebhookOutbox`, `CyrusWebhookReceipt`).

**Dual mode:** `test/cyrus-host-http.test.ts` runs one conformance suite on the fake platform and on `createHttpHost` over a real local HTTP server (settings, sign-in subjects, servers, file sessions, installs, wallet, mod pages, local build engine), plus a lost-response wallet charge applied once and real Cyrus code under `setHost(httpHost)`. Move-day steps: `docs/CYRUS-MOVE-RUNBOOK.md`.

Tests: `test/cyrus-api-writes.test.ts`, `test/cyrus-api-webhooks.test.ts`, the contract test also pins `OPERATIONS_CLIENT` to the live operations. Regenerate the contract after changing `lib/cyrus/api/v1`: `npx tsx tools/cyrus-api/gen-openapi.ts`.
EOF
echo ok

# AE - Cyrus separation finish + API v1 phase 2 (r34, 2026-10-11)
Branch `feature/cyrus-r34-separation2` (worktree `/tank/dev-worktrees/cyrus-r34`, from `feature/cyrus-r2`, r2 merged again at the end incl. r32 security). NOT merged into r2, NOT deployed, no migration run, no flag flipped. Nothing changes inside Nxeon: new host methods delegate to the same functions.

## Commits
1. `121d03300d` seam: baseline **40 -> 5** imports. Pure modules moved into `lib/cyrus/builder|mods` (old paths re-export). New `host.builds`, `host.mods`, `host.billing` (Stripe containment + wallet; default provider = Nxeon; `billing-own-stripe.ts` = the other option, unused). Left on purpose (client-safe/pure): rbac role table, net-policy JSON, token UI component, Terraria versions, mod-health rules.
2. `70ff6c55e7` API phase 2: 6 more live operations (create project, create build, request install + status, config values, library contribution), Idempotency-Key (replay / 422 / 409, scoped per key+subject+op), scopes `config:write` `library:write`, the subject's Mod Builder access rule, an audit row per write. Webhooks: 5 builders, outbox interface, signed dispatcher, retries 1m/5m/30m/2h/12h then dead. `lib/cyrus-client` (Nxeon side, no Cyrus imports): typed client + webhook receiver. SQL proposal `prisma/manual-migration-cyrus-api-v1.sql` (NOT run).
3. `2cc007a662` dual mode: the conformance suite now covers wallet, mod pages and the local build engine on both transports (fake platform, and `createHttpHost` over a real local HTTP server serving a fake Nxeon); plus a lost-response wallet charge applied once, and real Cyrus code under `setHost(httpHost)`. Runbook `docs/CYRUS-MOVE-RUNBOOK.md`.
4. `c606e5535a` docs (DOCUMENTATION.md section). Merge `e7ed10d509`.

## Ran (node-2 via devhost)
- `tsc --noEmit`: clean (after the final merge).
- Full Cyrus suite `test/cyrus-*.test.ts`: **2235/2235** pass (after the merge).
- Contract regenerated and pinned; contract test also pins the client's operation table.

## Design notes
- Writes reuse the product paths with the subject as the user, so every existing gate applies (plan/tokens, delivery checks and acks with `CYRUS_DELIVERY`, Config Studio service with `CYRUS_CONFIG_STUDIO`, contribution filters with `CYRUS_LIBRARY_CONTRIBUTE`). Install deps come from the route (`lib/modbuilder/delivery`), keeping lib/cyrus seam-clean.
- `modBuilderAccess(user)` extracted from `modBuilderUser()` unchanged; `host.builds.accountFor` uses it for API subjects.
- Wallet adapter (`host.billing.wallet`) is the "Nxeon is the payment provider" option: same conditional debit as other products + a WalletTransaction row; Cyrus does not call it yet.

## Not done / honest gaps
- Host API not mounted in Nxeon; no webhook emitted by product code (5 points listed in the runbook); no Postgres idempotency/outbox/receipt stores (memory, one instance only).
- No real HTTP run of the new write endpoints (fake-deps tests + tsc only); no next build.
- Wallet charge idempotency across Nxeon instances needs a unique reference column (proposal only).
- `git mv` of `lib/modbuilder/types.ts`/`client.ts` with shims: branches editing those files will conflict on merge (take the change into `lib/cyrus/builder/*`).

## Owner decisions
Section added to `OWNER-ACTIONS.md`: wallet vs own Stripe / SSO / domain (unchanged, both options pluggable), approve the SQL, wallet reference column, who may attest library contributions, which keys get write scopes, webhook emission wiring.
